story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED, in principle: the crew logs the true cost of the siege before anyone forgets it. Astro: "Now every cadet can see it in numbers, not just in memory."

=================
Before this review closes, read incident-cost.txt and sort each line into its cost category: financial, legal, trust, or operational.

1. type incident-cost.txt
2. classify <item> <category> for each of the four lines

steps.title: Read the after-action report

steps.title: Volt's Ledger: sort the damage
steps.body: Volt: "Four lines, four categories. Sort them so command can see the shape of it." Use `classify cost-shield-repair financial`, `classify cost-breach-notice legal`, `classify cost-ally-trust trust`, and `classify cost-mission-pause operational`.
